name: Goyal Aluminiums Limited
summary: Goyal Aluminiums Limited is mainly a trading company in India, founded in 2017 and based in New Delhi. It deals in aluminum extrusions, sheets, coils and scrap, as well as items such as cotton trousers, lithium-ion cells, rivets and rubber profiles, and also makes aluminum panels and components. It was formerly Advitiya Trade India Limited, renamed in October 2021.
